name: 3D Worlds Arena
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: Blindly explore and compare persistent, scene-scale 3D worlds generated from the same case: a starter image and caption, or for prompt-only LLM cases a text prompt alone. A ranked entry must be a self-contained GLB mesh, Gaussian-splat PLY/SPZ, or a native NeRF bundle with a validated deterministic browser derivative. Videos, panoramas, ordinary point clouds, isolated-object assets, and non-explorable NeRFs are rejected; the exception is an LLM case that asks for an object, such as the Boeing 747, whose program must still build it at real-world scale.

The public and admin Spaces are CPU-only. Generation uses separately budgeted Hugging Face Jobs and never runs in a viewer request. During development every repository, Dataset, Bucket, PR, input, output, preview, and score is private. At release, only the public Space, release Dataset, and artifact Bucket can be made public; ballots and operational state remain private.
